name: app.motiontone/motiontone
title: Motiontone
description: Motiontone is a browser-based motion graphics editor that syncs visuals to music.

tools.name: search_templates
tools.description: Use when the user wants an animated tour or show announcement, a gig or club-night flyer, a release announcement or countdown, a festival lineup, a lyric video, a music visualizer or a Spotify Canvas loop. Finds Motiontone templates that move to a song's beat. Returns each match with a preview image, a link that opens it in the browser editor, and its editable text blocks (blockId and current words), which open_template can replace. When nothing matches, returns popular templates with fallback set to true.

query.description: What the user wants to make, in plain words, e.g. 'tour dates announcement' or 'lyric video for a slow song'. Add any look or feel they describe. Moods: trippy, dreamy, dark, playful, hype, calm, bold, elegant, romantic, melancholy, euphoric, aggressive, mysterious, eerie, uplifting, gritty, epic, quirky, cozy, cute, sensual, triumphant. Styles: retro, minimal, 3d, hand-drawn, glitch, kinetic-type, collage, neon, grainy, geometric, y2k, vaporwave, synthwave, cyberpunk, futuristic, brutalist, swiss, maximalist, grunge, liquid, chrome, pixel-art, halftone, watercolor, line-art, isometric, low-poly, art-deco, anime, comic, editorial, gradient, organic.

bpm.description: The user's song tempo, when known.

tools.name: open_template
tools.description: Use after search_templates, once the user has picked a template or given their details. Returns a link that opens the template in the Motiontone browser editor with the user's own words (artist name, show dates, cities, venues, release title) already in its text blocks, keyed by the blockIds search_templates returned. The user can then add their song, keep editing and export. No account is needed to open or edit it.

text.description: New words keyed by blockId. Blocks left out keep the template's words.
